Conservative Party Conference 2026 | Does the British tax system back entrepreneurs?

Tuesday 6 October, 10.45-11.55.

Sonata Room, Hyatt Regency, 2 Bridge St, Birmingham, B1 2JZ.

Hosted by the Chartered Institute of Taxation and the Centre for the Analysis of Taxation.

The UK wants to be a great place to start and grow a business, but is the tax system helping or getting in the way? Ahead of Budget 2026, our panel brings together different perspectives from tax experts, business and a shadow minister to ask what the UK gets right, where it falls short, and what should change. Refreshments provided. 

Speakers
Shadow Exchequer Secretary to the Treasury, John Cooper MP
CIOT President, Paul Aplin OBE
Director at CenTax, Andy Summers
CBI Head of Tax Policy, Alice Jeffreys
Chair: Helen Whiteman, Chief Executive, CIOT 

Recordings will be online here shortly after the events.

(NB. This event is being held outside the conference secure zone so is open for members and others with an interest in the topic to attend.)
